company.name: Satispay
company.shortDescription: Satispay is a fintech company that provides a bank account enabled mobile payment platform.
company.description:
Satispay is a thriving European payment network with the goal to change the way people pay in stores and online, and exchange money between friends.

Launched in 2015, Satispay is independent from debit and credit cards. Easy and cost-convenient for businesses–who can accept payments from clients with a click on their smartphone, tablet, or pc–Satispay is also a simple and secure app for consumers, simplifying the way they pay, as well as a range of other services.

productsAndServices.description: A mobile payment and digital wallet app for paying in stores and online, transferring money to contacts, saving toward goals, and handling selected everyday payments and top-ups.
productsAndServices.name: Satispay App

productsAndServices.description: A merchant payment acceptance service that lets shops and businesses accept Satispay payments in physical stores and online, with integrations for checkout, POS, and cash-register workflows.
productsAndServices.name: Satispay Business

productsAndServices.description: A digital corporate-welfare platform that provides employers with meal vouchers, purchase vouchers, and flexible benefits that employees use through the Satispay app and affiliated merchant network.
productsAndServices.name: Satispay Welfare

productsAndServices.description: An investment service integrated into the Satispay app that enables users to invest small amounts, including recurring contributions, and withdraw funds subject to the applicable product terms and risks.
productsAndServices.name: Satispay Investments

productsAndServices.description: An IBAN-enabled account service that allows users to receive bank transfers and manage funds associated with their Satispay wallet.
productsAndServices.name: Satispay IBAN

productsAndServices.description: Mastercard debit cards linked to Satispay that enable users to pay in stores and online, including internationally, through card-based transactions.
productsAndServices.name: Satispay Debit Cards

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Debt Financing round raised $34,147,485, or 6.02% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.
caveats: Crunchbase reports 12 rounds but provides 10 detailed rows.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $5,212,830 to $1,185,317,052, a 227.38x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 91 (-3 over 90 days) and market heat at 61 (-10).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
